'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Aaron Kinser DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kinser]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
